outcome.technical:
Added scripts/export.mjs (CLI + pure functions toMermaidFlowchart(model, viewId), toMermaidER(model), toMermaidSequence(model, seqId), mermaidFiles). Validates via validate.mjs first (exit 1, nothing written, not even the exports dir); plantuml/md/svg/png and unknown formats exit 2 'not yet implemented'; --view unknown exits 2; default dir is /exports; --out is a directory (created). Flowchart: LR, zones as nested subgraphs (z_ prefix), nodes n_ prefix, edges labelled 'type' or 'type: label'. ER: PK/FK markers (FK from field.fk or relations), 1-n puts many on the from side (matching viewer.js manyEnds), n-m '}o--o{', 1-1 '||--||'. Sequence: participants, ->> calls, -->> for steps with ret, alt/else/opt/loop/end blocks (stray end/else dropped, open blocks closed), Note over. Escaping: one-pass numeric entity codes (#NN;) for quote # & ; < > [ ] { } | backslash backtick %, newline to
; ids sanitised with prefixes and collision suffixes (so 'end' is never an id); file names sanitised (no traversal, collision-free). Issue ids / steps[].i are never read. Tests: tests/export.test.mjs, 12 cases x1-x12, all pass; full node --test 240/240 pass. Dependants: tests/skill.test.mjs still correct (asserts SKILL.md still marks export.mjs 'not yet built'; SKILL.md untouched and full suite is green); docs/design.md and skills/architecture-map/SKILL.md unchanged and still correct (they describe export.mjs as planned/not yet built; later tasks update them).
